id.description: Stable .id from fresh discovery; never a row number

tag.description: Exact unique image tag, not a regex; prefer id when images are shared

interface.description: VETH interface(s); verify target syntax and image interface names

root_dir.description: Dedicated root path on appropriate storage, not internal flash

env.description: Sensitive inline environment; verify support on the target

envlist.description: Legacy singular envlist; exclusive with envlists

mount.description: Inline mount expression supported by the target; not Docker syntax

mounts.description: Legacy mounts reference; exclusive with mountlists

devices.description: Device passthrough; extra privilege requires explicit review

memory_high.description: Soft memory pressure threshold, not a hard cap

memory_max.description: Hard memory limit only where supported; can terminate processes
